tasks.title: Foundation
tasks.body: Next.js TypeScript app; Tailwind; Supabase wiring; minimal auth; PWA shell (manifest, icons, standalone presentation); navigation; CI/test scripts; Vercel-ready. No product features beyond the shell. PWA does NOT mean offline-first, background sync, service-worker caching architecture, or local-first replication.

tasks.title: Check-in
tasks.body: Mood, energy, sensory load, social battery, optional note; persistence and history. Minimal migration and RLS required.

tasks.title: Journal
tasks.body: Plain-text create/edit/delete/list; timestamps; delete confirmation; persistence and RLS. No AI, tags, search, rich text or photos.

tasks.title: Support
tasks.body: Static 2/5/10 minute meditation and movement options; user-started rain, ocean, fireplace and brown-noise soundscapes; simple timers. No mixer, streaming or CMS. Soundscape assets must be owned, public-domain or appropriately licensed, with attribution and licence recorded.

tasks.title: Companion
tasks.body: CompanionService over OpenRouter, text UI, persistence if required, safe prompt and wellbeing boundaries, graceful provider outage. No RAG, voice or diagnosis.

tasks.title: Jev Product Integration
tasks.body: DecisionService using the OpenRouter Decisions pattern; the approved six choices only (TALK, JOURNAL, MEDITATE, MOVE, SOUNDSCAPE, NOTHING); schema validation; deterministic fallback. No diagnosis or high-stakes decisions.

tasks.title: Insights
tasks.body: Deterministic SQL/TypeScript counts, mood history and distribution, activity and support usage, simple Recharts visualisation with accessible text summaries. No AI-calculated facts and no correlation engine.

tasks.title: Integration and Demo Journey
tasks.body: Connect Home, check-in, support, companion, journal and insights into one coherent low-stimulation flow. Clearly labelled synthetic demo data only if needed.

tasks.title: Release Stabilisation
tasks.body: E2E core journey; accessibility; mobile at 375px; desktop; failure modes; deployment; documentation. No new features.
